name: APTIV PLC
sector: Automotive parts / electrical architecture & intelligent systems (SIC 3714)
moat_justification: Design-in switching costs and embedded OEM engineering are real, but returns do not confirm a durable moat: fundamentals.json roic_proxy fell from 11.4% (FY2021) to 8.0%, 7.6%, 10.3% and 6.2% (FY2025), at/below cost of capital, and gross margin is only 15.1-19.1% over the last five fiscal years (19.1% in FY2025). OEM pricing pressure, concentrated customers and larger rivals (Bosch, Valeo, ZF) cap pricing power; the $648M Wind River goodwill impairment shows a key software bet was overpaid.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 6.6%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 10.0x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.3%) vs bull-case tier C (10.1%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Cyclical auto-tech supplier, moat 4/10 — does not clear 15% on the post-spin TTM base (weighted IRR 8.4%, IV@15 $21.32 vs $45.11 price); it would clear 15% only below $21.32, and the pre-spin median base that printed Tier A is not the business the price now buys.
moat_for: OEM design integration: engineers embedded years before production, architecture baked into vehicle platforms — high switching costs once specified
Global scale in electrical architecture / interconnect and leading ADAS / domain-controller positions
Smart Vehicle Architecture + Wind River software position for software-defined vehicles
Non-automotive diversification growing double digits (12% in Q2 2026) in industrials and aerospace/defense
moat_against: ROIC proxy falling and below cost of capital: 11.4% FY2021 to 6.2% FY2025 (fundamentals.json)
Low gross margin (19.1% FY2025) and OEM price-down pressure; top-10 OEM customers are a majority of sales
Larger diversified rivals (Bosch ~16% smart-architecture share vs Aptiv ~7.4%) and OEM vertical integration of compute platforms
$648M non-cash goodwill impairment on Wind River (FY2025) — software-defined-vehicle adoption slower than the price paid assumed
Cyclical global vehicle production and Motional autonomous-driving equity losses
